ns2:course.label: Intro to Computing, Eng & Sci
ns2:course.description: (C S 101) Fundamental principles, concepts, and methods of computing, with emphasis on applications in the physical sciences and engineering. Basic problem solving and programming techniques; fundamental algorithms and data structures; use of computers in solving engineering and scientific problems. Credit is not given for both CS 101 and either CS 105 or CS 110 section C. Prerequisite: MATH 220.
